technique_name: Describe the monetary policy of the Bank of England
description: The Bank of England's monetary policy is focused on using council decisions and interest rates to ensure monetary (money supply) and financial stability, as well as to support economic growth. The primary tool is changing the base interest rate of the UK economy, which is the price of borrowing from the Bank of England.
